title: Page 8
content_zh:
「他一直没接手机……」
「很显然是。」掌尚仁两手环胸，直盯着她看。「这里没有其他人，你可不可以用你原来的声音说话？」
「嘎？」原来他知道她是女的？
掌尚仁眨眼一笑。先前他还不知道掌尚勇那家伙干么那么好心，一口就答应他继续当代理总裁，现在他大概了解，绝对是为了眼前这个「保特瓶」——呃，保特助。
虽然掌尚勇没告诉他她是女的，但他掌尚仁阅女无数，眼一瞄，她是男是女，绝对瞒不过他这双超闪的桃花眼。
这都不是重点，重点是，掌尚勇人究竟死到哪里去了！
电话响起，管家来报，「那个人」回到家了。
「很好，你的总裁、我的小弟回家了，而我们两个笨蛋……不是，是两个俊男美女却傻傻地在这里等他。」
「你们的管家有说他……总裁去哪里吗？」
「冲浪。」他挑眉，非常不以为然。「这个人该不会常放着公事不管，兴致一来，就去玩冲浪吧？」
「没有！」她急急反驳。「总裁很认真，他从来没有在上班时间出去玩过。」
这么护主？好吧，她说是就是，反正他的爱车平安回家就好。
「我要回家了，后天我和我老婆要去义大利，那小子……我是说你的总裁，拜托盯紧他，不要让他出状况，让我们能顺利出国，好吗？」
「副总裁，你和你的老婆要去义大利？」
「对。」说到这个，某仁就心花怒放。「我们在希腊的小教堂完成终身大事，我的老婆精得很，她说那不算蜜月旅行，一定要再去别的地方玩，她想去佛罗伦斯，我忘了告诉你，我老婆可以算是个艺术家，她的设计风格很独特，她做手工包，都是自己设计自己缝制，在贵妇团里可是抢手货。」
「那她还没嫁你之前，一定是很有才华的名媛千金。」
「名媛千金？呃，并不是，她是我的小学同学，家境……普通，不过她很有才华，也很漂亮。」才说完，手机铃声就响起，他看了一下，对她笑，「是我老婆打来的。」
掌尚仁帅气的接起。「亲爱的，我正在想你、正在称赞你貌美如花，你就打来了，什么？我的跑车……全都是土……可恶的掌尚勇！好，没关系，我会忍耐的，等我们去义大利回来，我再找他算这笔帐。有，公司应该有车，我马上回去，你会等我，我就知道老婆最爱我……」
掌尚仁边说边和保贝儿挥挥手，旋即快步离开。
保贝儿杵在原地，傻眼呆望。两个人明明是亲兄弟，个性怎会差那么多？那些肉麻到让女人心花怒放的话，就算拿关刀压在掌尚勇的脖子上，他一定宁愿被砍也不愿讲上一句。

不过重点是，二少说他老婆家境……普通，那意思是她并不是名媛千金，既然他们已经结婚，那是不是代表掌家父母能够接受「门不当、户不对」的媳妇？
仿佛打了一剂强心针，她忍不住笑了开来。
只是，尚勇为什么突然跑去冲浪？他不是会丢下工作，只顾玩乐的人……
想了想，也许是二少回来，他特地放自己半天假，去玩他一直想玩的冲浪，一定是这样没错，他也该放松一下，从当上代理总裁以来，他一直没时问去冲浪。
今天他玩了一下午，一定很累了，她就不去打扰，让他好好休息吧。
==============================================================
翌日，保贝儿提了一个小袋子进公司，等到掌尚勇一进入总裁办公室，她像个现宝的小孩一样，他说：「尚勇，我帮你准备了早餐，是寿司哦。」她娇嗔道：「我的厨艺不太好，可是每一个寿司都是我用爱心去做的，你吃吃看。」
昨晚入睡前，她突然想到自己从未做过饭给他吃，虽然她的厨艺糟透了，但是包个寿司应该不难，是以，早上她一起床便赶紧去买材料，用心做了五盒的寿司，让他有爱心早餐吃。
瞥了桌上五盒寿司一眼，掌尚勇淡淡地说：「我在家里吃过早餐了。」
说罢，他坐进牛皮椅，开电脑的同时，翻阅着桌上的卷宗，开始一天的工作。
若是之前她这么用心做早餐给他吃，不管他有没有在家里吃过，一定会捧场，至少吃上两盒，但今天，虽看得出来那是她特地做的，可是看到那些寿司，他马上联想到她以前应该也做给沈嘉雄那家伙吃过……
心口闷到最高点。
没错，他就是在吃醋！
昨天看到沈嘉雄扶她搭计程车，他整个人不爽到了极点，后来听二哥说她在公司打了一下午的电话找他，那就代表她没有跟沈嘉雄去别的地方。心中的怒气减少了三分，可是，他还是很生气。
他也不知道自己怎么了，以前交过的女朋友，若她们有前男友，他也不会太介意，其中有一个还因为想测试他爱她有多深，故意跟他说她和前男友去看电影，他都觉得无所谓，看场电影嘛，但是昨天沈嘉雄「只是」扶贝儿搭计程车而已，他就火冒三丈，气到狂飙到乌石港冲浪。藉海水冲掉他满身怒气。
没想到气消了，但醋意仍是未消一分一毫。
等不到他「光顾」她的爱心早餐，保贝儿脸上掩不住失望，但仍微笑道：「没关系，晚一点你如果饿了再吃。」
一直到下班前，五盒寿司只吃了一盒，被吃光的那一盒包含她的早餐和午餐。
心中的失望无限扩大，他看起来似乎在生气，又在生自己的气？一整天，他和她的交集不多，他专心工作，她也不敢吵他。
「总裁，你的手机响了。」他的手机响了很久，他似乎没听到。

看了她一眼，他烦躁地接起手机。
「嗯，是我……你的车子坏了……在公司附近……好，我知道，我现在就过去看看。」关上手机，起身离开前，他回头看她一眼，「你先走吧！」
看着他急匆匆消失的背影，保贝儿心中怅然若失，今天他对她好冷淡，好像她做错什么事惹他生气。
看着自己早上兴致勃勃做的寿司，他连一个都没吃，心中委屈陡升。
把东西收拾好，她落寞地走出总裁办公室。昨天她自己回家，今天也是，那明天呢？
深吸一口气，她告诉自己不要想太多。好久没搭公车，今天就去搭公车，时间还早，她可以换两班车到医院去探望哥哥，顺便请母亲教她怎么煮姜母鸭，学成后，她就可以煮给他吃。
也许，他比较喜欢吃姜母鸭。
============================================================
她不用请教母亲怎么煮姜母鸭了。
眼前的画面让她懂了，为什么今天他对她那么冷淡，连吃都不愿吃她做的寿司。
搭上公车，才过了一站，她就看到对街有个高大熟悉的身影，他露出今天一整天她都「无缘」一见的笑容，还轻搂着一位站在一辆红色跑车旁打扮时髦的年轻女子。
上车乘客坐定后，公车往前驶，她的视线直盯着他们不放，看见他们往公司的方向走，一辆机车急速经过，他反应极快拉女子站入内侧，他则走在外边保护她。
content_en:
"He never answered the phone..."
"Obviously." Zhang Shangren crossed his arms over his chest and stared at her. "There's no one else here, could you please speak in your original voice?"
"Huh?" So he knew she was a woman?
Zhang Shangren blinked and smiled. Before, he didn't know why Zhang Shangyong was so kind and agreed to continue being the acting president. Now he roughly understood that it was definitely because of the "Pote Bottle" in front of him - er, the Botte Assistant.
Although Zhang Shangyong didn't tell him that she was a girl, he palmed Shang Ren and had countless women. He could tell whether she was a boy or a girl at a glance, and his pair of super-dazzling peach blossom eyes could never be concealed.
This is not the point. The point is, where did Zhang Shang Yongren die?
The phone rang and the housekeeper came to report that "that man" was back home.
"Very good, your CEO and my little brother have gone home, and we two idiots... no, two handsome men and beauties are waiting here for him stupidly."
"Did your butler tell you where his... president is going?"
"Surfing." He raised his eyebrows, very disapproving. "Does this person always leave business alone and go surfing whenever the mood strikes?"
"No!" she retorted hastily. "The president is very serious. He never goes out to play during work hours."
So protective of the Lord? Well, she said yes, as long as his car got home safely.
"I'm going home. My wife and I are going to Italy the day after tomorrow. That boy...I mean your CEO, please keep an eye on him and don't let him get into trouble so that we can go abroad smoothly, okay?"
"Vice President, are you and your wife going to Italy?"
"Yes." When he said this, Mouren became elated. "We completed a lifelong event in a small church in Greece. My wife is very smart. She said that it was not a honeymoon trip and she must go somewhere else. She wanted to go to Florence. I forgot to tell you that my wife can be regarded as an artist. Her design style is very unique. She makes handmade bags that she designs and sews herself. They are popular among the ladies."
"Then before she married you, she must have been a very talented daughter of a famous lady."
"The daughter of a famous lady? Well, no, she is my elementary school classmate. Her family background is... ordinary, but she is very talented and beautiful." Just after he finished speaking, his cell phone rang. He looked at it and smiled at her, "It's my wife calling."
Zhang Shangren picked up the call handsomely. "My dear, I was thinking of you and praising your beauty, and you called me, what? My sports car... is all filled with dirt... damn Zhang Shangyong! Okay, it doesn't matter, I will be patient. When we come back from Italy, I will find him to settle the account. Yes, the company should have a car, I will go back immediately, you will wait for me, I know that my wife loves me the most..."
As Zhang Shangren spoke, he waved to Bao Beier and left quickly.
Bao Beier stayed on the spot, staring dumbfounded. The two are obviously brothers, how could their personalities be so different? Those words that are so disgusting that they make a woman's heart flutter, even if a Guan Dao is pressed on Zhang Shangyong's neck, he would rather be chopped than say a word.
But the point is, the second young master said that his wife's family background is... ordinary, which means that she is not a daughter of a famous lady. Now that they are married, does that mean that the head of the family can accept a daughter-in-law from the wrong family or household?
As if she had been given a shot in the arm, she couldn't help but smile.
But why did Shang Yong suddenly go surfing? He is not someone who would leave his job and just have fun...
After thinking about it, maybe it was because the Second Young Master came back that he gave himself half a day off to go surfing, which he had always wanted to do. This must be true. He should also relax. Since he became the acting president, he has never had time to go surfing.
He must be very tired after playing all afternoon today, so she won't disturb him and let him have a good rest.
==============================================================
The next day, Bao Beier brought a small bag into the company. When her boss, Shang Yong, entered the president's office, she was like a child with a treasure. He said, "Shang Yong, I prepared breakfast for you. It's sushi." She said coquettishly, "My cooking skills are not very good, but every sushi is made with love by me. You can eat it and see."
Before going to bed last night, she suddenly remembered that she had never cooked for him. Although her cooking skills were terrible, it shouldn't be difficult to make sushi. Therefore, as soon as she got up in the morning, she hurriedly bought the ingredients and carefully made five boxes of sushi for him to eat for breakfast.
Glancing at the five boxes of sushi on the table, Zhang Shangyong said calmly: "I've had breakfast at home."
After that, he sat down in the cowhide chair, turned on the computer, flipped through the files on the table, and started his day's work.
If she had made breakfast for him with so much care before, no matter whether he had eaten it at home or not, he would have definitely supported it and eaten at least two boxes. But today, although it was obvious that she made it specially, when he saw the sushi, he immediately thought that she should have made it for that guy Shen Jiaxiong before...
My heart was feeling stuffy to the highest point.
Yes, he is jealous!
Yesterday, he was extremely upset when he saw Shen Jiaxiong helping her take a taxi. Later, he heard from his second brother that she had been calling him at the company all afternoon, which meant that she did not go anywhere else with Shen Jiaxiong. The anger in his heart decreased by three points, but he was still very angry.
He didn't know what was wrong with him. He wouldn't mind too much if his previous girlfriends had ex-boyfriends. One of them even wanted to test how deeply he loved her, so she deliberately told him that she and her ex-boyfriend were going to the movies. He thought it didn't matter, just a movie. But yesterday, Shen Jiaxiong "just" helped Belle take a taxi, so he got so angry that he went surfing at Wushi Port. Use the sea water to wash away his anger.
Unexpectedly, the anger had subsided, but the jealousy was still there.
Bao Beier couldn't hide her disappointment when she couldn't wait for him to "patronize" her love breakfast, but she still smiled and said, "It doesn't matter. You can eat later if you are hungry."
Until she got off work, she had only eaten one of the five boxes of sushi, and the one that was eaten included her breakfast and lunch.
The disappointment in his heart expanded infinitely. He seemed to be angry, and also angry with himself? Throughout the whole day, he didn't have much interaction with her. He concentrated on his work, and she didn't dare to disturb him.
"President, your cell phone is ringing." His cell phone rang for a long time, and he didn't seem to hear it.
Glancing at her, he picked up the phone irritably.
"Well, it's me...your car broke down...near the company...Okay, I know, I'll go over and have a look now." He turned around and looked at her before closing the phone and getting up to leave, "You go first!"
Watching his hurriedly disappearing figure, Bao Beier felt disappointed. He was so cold to her today, as if she had done something wrong to make him angry.
Looking at the sushi he made with great enthusiasm in the morning, he didn't even eat any of it, and his grievance rose sharply.
After packing her things, she walked out of the president's office lonely. She went home by herself yesterday, and she went home by herself today, but what about tomorrow?
Taking a deep breath, she told herself not to think too much. She hadn't taken a bus for a long time, so she took a bus today. It was still early, so she could change two buses to visit her brother in the hospital. By the way, she could ask her mother to teach her how to cook ginger duck. After she learned how to cook ginger duck, she could cook it for him.
Maybe, he prefers ginger duck.
============================================================
She no longer has to ask her mother how to cook ginger duck.
The scene in front of her made her understand why he was so cold to her today and wouldn't even eat.I would like to eat the sushi she makes.
After getting on the bus, she saw a tall, familiar figure across the street after just one stop. He smiled in a way that she had not seen all day long, and gently hugged a fashionably dressed young woman standing next to a red sports car.
After the passengers sat down on the bus, the bus moved forward. She kept her eyes on them and saw them walking towards the company. A motorcycle passed by quickly. He reacted quickly and pulled the woman to stand inside, while he walked outside to protect her.
